title: Parallax Spatial Studio and Versioned Spatial Library
summary: Creators build, preview, validate and version spatial scenes in a dedicated Studio, attach exact immutable versions to Chronicles, and publish/reopen them through the existing One Voyage flow.
subfeatures: Spatial canvas with direct and keyboard manipulation
Scene hierarchy, layers, visibility, locking and object inspection
Declarative behavior timeline with deterministic runtime evaluation
Guided, Detailed and Engineering authoring modes
Creator-owned library scopes, immutable versions, forks and provenance
Five editable first-party presets and ten synthetic reference environments
Reviewed AI intent and critique adapters with deterministic edits and undo/redo
Checksum-pinned Chronicle attachments with reversible attachment history
Selected-object Drydock links and asset, scale and performance validation
limitations: Local software qualification does not establish representative-device owner acceptance or D4 physical AR evidence.
Spatial Assistant requires server-side OpenAI configuration and enabled administrator policy; full live-corpus quality and owner presentation review remain separate gates.
Synthetic previews and complexity estimates do not establish measured device frame rates or shared-anchor synchronization.
Unsupported imported renderer assets block release; richer rendering, recognition, shared physical anchors and Reach manipulation remain governed by their owning phases.

title: Parallax Adaptive Semantic Staging and Discovery
summary: Creators author multi-object semantic scenes remotely, preview differing safe arrangements, publish stable version-bound logical placement policies, and provide bounded accessible discovery with optional consented metadata calibration in the refined 3D workstation.
subfeatures: Typed semantic surfaces, context, safety, accessibility and fallback recipes
Deterministic unsafe-first multi-entity staging with bounded scene budgets and conflict diagnostics
Sticky, crew, run, variant and calibrated policies with durable logical decisions
Provider-independent guided remote authoring and reviewable supported phrase preview
Real 3D editing with four workspace layouts, adaptive resizable docks and account-scoped presentation preferences
Meaningful search timers, progressive hints, exact reveal and accessible canonical completion paths
Optional minimized field metadata with consent, withdrawal, retention, authorized sequential review and immutable calibration releases
Separate simulated and self-reported quality summaries with actionable Creator guidance
Shared Device Lab runtime and field-service packs plus complete Creator and Player publication/republication browser journeys
limitations: Physical AR accuracy, actual field reliability, representative-device performance and cross-device physical alignment are not established by synthetic software proof.
Native semantic candidate acquisition is unavailable; existing adapters degrade to Guided rather than invent geometry.
Physical provenance is self-reported; simulation cannot promote physical maturity and neither establishes certified hardware attestation.
Automatic room-image transfer is disabled until certified local person/face screening and the approved protected-media purpose are available.
Full live AI-provider corpus quality and unsupported imported renderers remain unqualified; Assistant A1 is integrated through its own software qualification.

title: Parallax Spatial Assistant and AI Resource Controls
summary: Creators describe spatial ideas, inspect validated proposals in the real canvas and explicitly apply canonical saved edits, while administrators govern durable usage and spending through existing Admiralty account and policy controls.
subfeatures: Deliberate natural-language requests with standard Luna and authorized advanced Sol assistance
Strict typed supported operations, dependency-closed review and deterministic scene validation
Actual current/proposed canvas preview, affected-object feedback and accessible Guided alternatives
Atomic canonical saved Apply with durable replay, ordinary history and stale-scene protection
Bounded owner-scoped clarification and follow-up context with private scene exclusions
Durable user/global allowances, conservative reservations, usage settlement and concurrent admission control
Global Admiralty overview, reviewed policy, history and safe provider diagnostics
Per-user usage and reviewed overrides in the existing People account dossier
Shared Windows user environment configuration across independent local worktrees
Responsive floating/docked review, preserved phone canvas switching and reduced motion
limitations: Assistance and advanced access start disabled and require administrator activation plus server configuration.
Owner visual acceptance remains pending; browser viewport proof does not establish physical phone keyboard or touch comfort.
Six bounded live calls validate transport, structured interpretation and settlement; corrected corpus matching has deterministic proof and full live-corpus quality is not established.
Independent databases enforce their own local quotas; shared credentials do not create a shared cross-worktree ledger.
Physical illumination, particles, custom materials, recognition and certified physical AR quality are outside supported Assistant operations.
